selection_rule: minimum average season margin RMSE, grid .50-1.25 by .01
out_of_time_evaluation: see ../baseline_review/early_game_yearly.csv: each 2022-2026 forecast uses the preceding five seasons only
limitations: Recent evaluation periods already inspected; these are retrospective comparisons, not a fresh untouched holdout
History-only calibration does not validate provisional player, recruiting or coaching terms
Calibration is specific to the existing tempo and 3.5-point home-advantage rule
No betting/ATS performance claim; no target-season games are used
Coaching-change residuals are recomputed against the recalibrated baseline, while unchanged coaches still get zero bonus
